query: SELECT l.link_id AS "link_id!: String", l.from_task AS "from_task!: String", l.link_kind AS "link_kind!: String", l.to_task AS "to_task!: String", fw.project_id AS "from_project?: String", tw.project_id AS "to_project?: String" FROM task_links l LEFT JOIN tasks ft ON ft.task_id=l.from_task LEFT JOIN workstreams fw ON fw.workstream_id=ft.workstream_id LEFT JOIN tasks tt ON tt.task_id=l.to_task LEFT JOIN workstreams tw ON tw.workstream_id=tt.workstream_id ORDER BY l.from_task, l.link_kind, l.to_task
